Charlie Melchoir and George Powell have again shown up well in the Javelin, and lent valuable assistance in the Shot and Discus events. Charlie has again been honoured by the A.A.A. in representative matches.
Charlie Melchoir and George Powell will form a strong Javelin duo and will have Frank Simmons to back them up. Jerry Thompson will be our star in the Shot and Discus, assisted by Melchoir and Powell.
In the field events, Charlie Melchoir was second in the Javelin and third in the Shot Putt. Young Stinton did 5 ft. 6 ins. in the High Jump Final match scores were: Belgrave H., 57 points; Met.

Charlie Melchoir retained his javelin title with Les Higgins as runner-up. Our old stalwart, George Powell, has been consistently throwing the javelin over 140 ft. in matches and has been a source of inspiration to younger aspirants.
